offer.title: Entry-level Cloud Security Engineer
offer.job_text: Permanent entry-level cloud security role in Geneva. Recent graduates are welcome. You will assist with AWS IAM reviews, vulnerability scanning, Terraform policy checks, Linux hardening and Python security automation. A senior engineer provides structured training and reviews all production changes. No prior full-time cloud security experience is required.
